name: MUSAN: A Music, Speech, and Noise Corpus
description: MUSAN is a corpus of music, speech, and noise designed for training robust speech recognition, speaker identification, and audio augmentation systems. It contains approximately 109 hours of audio files comprising 60 hours of speech in 12 languages, 42 hours of diverse musical genres, and 6 hours of technical and natural background noise.
